snippet.title: Video Dev Blog: Turinium Victory | Ashes of the Singularity II
snippet.description:
In this dev journal, we're taking a look at the Turinium Victory condition coming to Ashes of the Singularity II. It's a returning win condition from the original game where teams compete to hold Turinium generators and accumulate points, giving you a way to end matches without having to hunt down every opponent on the map. We walk through a live match, break down how generator placement works, and show off the customizable victory settings so you can tune how long you want your games to run.

Wishlist Ashes of the Singularity 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/Ashes_of_the_Singularity_II/
